title: 710,000 Hospital Visits: Last Flu Season Was Brutal
hook: Most people hospitalized with the flu last season had skipped the shot.
closing: The shot isn't perfect, but most who landed in the hospital skipped it. Get yours.
question: Did you get your flu shot?

segments.say: Flu sent roughly 710,000 Americans to hospital beds last season, making the season brutally severe.
Older adults got hit hardest. People 75 and up were hospitalized at nearly five times the overall rate.
Only about one in three hospitalized flu patients had gotten a flu shot. Two in three had skipped it.
